summary: A Claude turn ended by Stop still gets its diff cards (Reject only for files this chat's tools wrote), as Codex and OpenCode turns already did. A Claude turn whose prompt no longer fits the context window compacts and sends the turn again once instead of showing a raw "Prompt is too long", and a profile restart that resumed its own native session no longer gets the visible history replayed on top of it.

reactNativeIos.reason: Backend-only fix. The Expo app already renders the file.edited cards, the reasoning notice and the error event the backend sends; no client code or wire shape changes.

nativeAndroid.reason: Backend-only fix. Android already renders the file.edited cards, the reasoning notice and the error event the backend sends; no client code or wire shape changes.

storageDataMigration.reason: No schema or stored-format change. The diff cards a stopped turn now gets are stored through the existing file.edited mirror and turn_checkpoints rows.

updateRelease.reason: No new event, channel or capability. Older clients see the same event types they already handle; the headless server ships the fix with the desktop build.

notExercised: A live Claude Stop that ends with an AbortError, or with no result, has not been reproduced; the logs show the CLI usually sends a result, which already got cards. The fix covers the other two endings, tested with a mocked SDK.

A live "Prompt is too long" after a profile switch has not been reproduced; the CLI's synthetic message and result shapes are taken from the SDK 0.3.260 types (terminal_reason prompt_too_long) and tested with a mocked SDK. Whether /compact itself fits on the smaller window depends on the CLI's own compaction; when it does not, the chat shows a clear message.
